# MELD

> MELD is a hair density filler for men: a fine micro-powder that covers thinning areas and bald spots and creates the look of fuller, denser hair in seconds. It is long-lasting, sweat-resistant, and virtually undetectable, and washes out with any shampoo. MELD is powered by Meldfuse, our name for the way the fine micro-powder clings to and blends with your existing hair. MELD is a cosmetic, not a drug: it covers thinning, it does not treat hair loss. Free US shipping, a 60-day money-back guarantee, a Free Shade Swap, and four shades (Black, Dark Brown, Light Brown, Blonde). Priced $35 to $59.
